svg.title: ALU — INCOMPLETE; 19 disconnected sections
svg.desc: Thick paths are actual top-side wires ending at individual holes. Thin dashed net-colored links in Underneath-connections join adjacent holes beneath the board. Read validation.json before construction; power and fixed ties are listed separately.
